comparator.name: Bachelor Mechanical Engineering
comparator.sourceNotes: The University of Twente's current-student curriculum page explicitly identifies the 2026-2027 programme, states that the bachelor totals 180 EC, and defines twelve consecutive 15-EC modules. The first eight modules are compulsory mechanical-engineering modules; the first semester of year three is a genuine 30-EC minor, followed by Production Systems Engineering and the ME Bachelor Assignment. Recording the curriculum at the official module level preserves all 180 EC without inventing a minor choice or splitting integrated project-based modules into artificial alternatives.

programmes.label: Bachelor Mechanical Engineering at University of Twente

exception.reason: Twente's Mechanical Engineering bachelor is an integrated engineering sequence in statics, mechanics of materials, thermodynamics, materials science, manufacturing, machine elements, dynamics, elasticity, tribology, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, control engineering, mechatronics, finite-element methods and production systems. These subjects support eight consecutive design, analysis and manufacturing projects before a mechanical-engineering research assignment. UCR offers useful mathematics, programming, product-design and sustainability courses, but it does not offer the mechanical-science core, engineering laboratory and workshop sequence, or progressive mechanical design and research sequence on which the degree depends. A 24-course response would be an applied mathematics, computing and sustainable-design programme, not Mechanical Engineering.
exception.curriculumContext: The official 2026-27 curriculum accounts for all 180 EC as twelve 15-EC modules. Years one and two contain eight compulsory integrated mechanical-engineering modules. Year three preserves 30 EC of genuine minor space and then requires Production Systems Engineering and the ME Bachelor Assignment. The programme has no named graduation route requiring selection.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR course rows, including descriptions, outline-derived profiles, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned semesters. DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH211 Linear Algebra, DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus, DISMATH213 Computational & Numerical Methods, DISMATH312 Linear Systems and DISMATH314 Probability & Statistics provide relevant quantitative tools, while DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming adds computing. BENENTR111 Consumer Product Design covers customer needs, fabrication planning, prototyping and sustainability; ENSSUST112 Life Cycle Analysis & Circular Economy and ENSSUST311 Renewable System Design address environmental impact and sustainable energy-system assessment. The workbook nevertheless contains no statics or mechanics-of-materials course; no thermodynamics, fluid-mechanics or heat-transfer sequence; no engineering materials, machine elements, manufacturing-process, elasticity, tribology, dynamics, mechatronics or finite-element course; and no mechanical-engineering laboratory, workshop, integrated design-project or bachelor-research sequence. The adjacent courses cannot supply a coherent 23-course non-PPD mechanical-engineering pathway.
